# Sanhoti Bengali Association of Orange County

> Sanhoti (সংহতি) is a 501(c)(3) non-profit Bengali cultural association serving Orange County
> and Southern California, CA. We host Durga Puja, Saraswati Puja, Poila Boishakh (Bengali New
> Year), Kali Puja, and live Bengali concerts. Based in Rancho Santa Margarita. EIN 39-2903777.
> Contact: info@sanhoti.org · +1 949-378-6425.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.sanhoti.org/): overview of Sanhoti and upcoming events.
- [Durga Puja in Orange County](https://www.sanhoti.org/durga-puja): dates, venue, tickets, schedule.
- [Bengali Festivals](https://www.sanhoti.org/festivals): Durga Puja, Saraswati Puja, Poila Boishakh, Kali Puja.
- [Bollywood & Bengali Concerts](https://www.sanhoti.org/bollywood-concerts): live concert line-up and tickets.
- [Corporate Partnerships & CSR](https://www.sanhoti.org/corporate-partnerships): sponsorship, matching gifts, and CSR giving.
- [Events](https://www.sanhoti.org/events): all upcoming and recent events.
- [About](https://www.sanhoti.org/about) · [Contact](https://www.sanhoti.org/contact) · [Donate](https://www.sanhoti.org/donate)
